intro:
Can you spot the unease
hiding in class?
description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary day at school.
But look closer, and a small sense of unease may point to a chilling truth.

Use the question as your guide, study the illustration carefully, and find the suspicious spot that leads to the truth in this visual deduction quiz.

How to play is simple!
・Read the question
・Take a close look at the school illustration
・Choose the place you think is suspicious

Classrooms, hallways, club activities, and after-school scenes set the stage for strange moments hiding inside familiar school life.

A scene that seemed normal at first might feel completely different once you realize what it really means.

No complicated steps—just observation and a flash of insight. Take your time solo, or play with family and friends while asking, Which part looks off?

Recommended if you like:
・Stories that turn creepy once you understand them
・Horror and mystery
・Illustration observation quizzes
・Testing your deduction and attention to detail
・Quick quiz games you can enjoy in short breaks

Can you notice every uneasy detail hidden at school?
